name: Lumma: ClickFix hidden encoded PowerShell cradle
description: Hidden-window encoded-command PowerShell launched via the ClickFix (fake CAPTCHA) clipboard-to-Win+R path (T1204.002/T1059.001) — the documented LummaC2 / Water Kurita delivery primitive that downloads the stager with a WebClient cradle.
query: process where process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line : ("*-encodedcommand*", "* -enc *") and process.command_line : ("*hidden*")
false_positives: Legitimate encoded deployment scripts — baseline signed management agents; tighten to process.parent.name == explorer.exe for the Win+R paste path

name: Lumma: mshta.exe remote HTTP content fetch
description: mshta.exe invoked with a remote http(s) URL (T1204.002) — secondary ClickFix delivery LOLBin in the documented Lumma chain mshta → VBScript → PowerShell.
false_positives: Rare legacy application-compatibility packages; verify signer

name: Lumma: browser updater masquerade from user-writable path
description: MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe / GoogleUpdate.exe executing outside Program Files (T1055.003/T1036.005) — the Lumma self-copy injector that performs VirtualAllocEx + WriteProcessMemory + CreateRemoteThread and thread-context hijacking into a browser-named host process.
query: process where process.name : ("MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe", "GoogleUpdate.exe") and process.executable : ("C:\\Users\\*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Temp\\*") and not process.executable : "*\\Google\\Update\\GoogleUpdate.exe"
false_positives: Per-user Chrome installs legitimately run GoogleUpdate.exe from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Update (excluded); MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe has no legitimate user-path install

name: Lumma: browser credential stores copied by non-browser process
description: Non-browser process copying Chromium credential stores (Login Data, Cookies, Web Data, Local State) to a scratch location (T1555.003/T1555/T1005) — the stealer lock workaround preceding DPAPI CryptUnprotectData key unwrap and AES-GCM v10 decryption; also covers KeePass .kdbx, Gecko key4.db/logins.json and MetaMask wallet extension storage.
query: file where (file.name : ("Login Data", "Cookies", "Web Data", "Local State", "key4.db", "logins.json") or file.name : "*.kdbx" or file.path : "*nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn*") and file.path : ("C:\\Users\\*\\Temp\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "C:\\Users\\Public\\*") and not process.executable : ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*") and not process.name : ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "keepass.exe", "keepassxc.exe")
false_positives: Browser profile backup/migration tools and DFIR collectors — allowlist by signer

name: Lumma: LummaC2 channel - TeslaBrowser UA, c2sock/act=live handshake
description: Exfiltration channel with the hardcoded LummaC2 User-Agent TeslaBrowser/5.5, /c2sock endpoint, act=live handshake or LID form parameters (T1041/T1071.001) — requires HTTP-layer telemetry (Elastic packet/Zeek/proxy integrations supplying user_agent.original / url.original).
false_positives: None expected — UA and handshake URI are actor-specific; ensure url/user_agent fields come from HTTP inspection, not flow-only telemetry

name: Lumma: infostealer chain - masqueraded injector, credential harvest, C2 upload
description: Sequence correlation of the full Lumma kill chain on one host within 1h (T1055.003 + T1555.003 + T1041): user-path updater masquerade, then browser credential store collection, then LummaC2 channel activity.
query: sequence by host.id with maxspan=1h [process where process.name : ("MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe", "GoogleUpdate.exe") and process.executable : "C:\\Users\\*"] [file where file.name : ("Login Data", "Cookies", "Web Data", "key4.db", "logins.json") or file.name : "*.kdbx"] [network where url.original : ("*c2sock*", "*act=live*") or user_agent.original : "TeslaBrowser*"]
false_positives: Very low — three independent technique signals inside one hour on one host
